subtitle: Plan your journey across the network.
searchPlaceholder: Station, code, or X Y Z coordinates
searchHint: Search names in any language, station codes, or coordinates.
readyBody: Choose two stations using search or the map.
noRoute: No route is available with these options.
copyFailed: Select and copy the text below.
sameStation: You are already at your destination.
mapHint: Tap a station to set the active field. Tap the departure/destination button to switch. Drag to pan; pinch or scroll to zoom.
mapEditorHint: Select a line to drag its bends. Use Add bend, or Shift + click a line. Drag stations; drag labels to choose one of eight directions. Right-click a bend to remove it. Pinch to zoom with two fingers.
loadError: This network could not be loaded. Check your connection or choose a cached system.
fareNote: Adult single fares use the official origin–destination table. Outside-station transfers assume entry within 20 minutes.
fareBreakNote: The estimated outside-station transfer exceeds 20 minutes; separate journey fares apply.
editorTitle: Build the network. Shape the map.
editorSubtitle: Edit locally, preview immediately, and export one portable JSON file.
deleteConfirm: Delete this item and all connections that reference it?
transferSlope: Additional seconds per transfer familiarity level
conditionsHint: Optional timing variants use declarative option values. Edit them as JSON below.
nothingSelected: Choose an item to edit, or select a station on the map.
duplicateId: This identifier is already in use or is invalid.
editorLocal: Open and edit a local JSON file, then download your changes. This does not change the website’s default maps.
invalidNetwork: Fix validation errors before exporting or previewing.
UNKNOWN_STATION: Select valid departure and destination stations.
footer: FTMC Route Planner v2 · Calculated on your device
unsavedChanges: Your edits have not been downloaded as JSON. Switch networks and discard them? Cancel to keep editing.
historyLoadWarning: The network is valid, but its edit history is damaged. OK: load the network, discard the damaged group and all earlier groups (plus any later groups that cannot be safely replayed). {discarded} groups will be lost; {retained} validated groups will remain. Cancel: reject the entire JSON and keep your current network and history.
historyLoadRejected: JSON was not loaded. Your current network and history were kept.
historyLoadRecovered: Network loaded. Discarded {discarded} history groups; retained {retained} validated groups.
historyEditRecovered: Edit saved. Unusable earlier history was discarded and the redo branch was replaced.
clearHistoryConfirm: Clear all undo and redo history? Your current network will be kept. This cannot be undone.
historyError: Invalid edit history: the operation was not applied.
invalidDraft: Some pending edits are invalid. Fix them or cancel pending edits before continuing.
countTransfer: Count cart changes within the same line
clickPoint: Click a line to place a bend
pointsHint: Select a connection to show its bends. Drag circles to move them; right-click or Delete to remove. Arrow keys move the focused bend.
defaultsHint: Suggestions follow nearby sections and common direction codes on the same line. Distance uses game XYZ coordinates; missing coordinates and transfers use 0. Manual edits turn off automatic suggestions.
fileReadError: Unable to read this JSON file.
applyDirectionLabels: Apply to all {count} sections of line {line}, direction {direction}
applyDirectionLabelsConfirm: Line {line}, direction {direction} has {count} sections with these existing texts:
applyDirectionLabelsWarning: Matching forward and reverse texts will be replaced by the currently edited text, including all languages. Other lines and directions remain unchanged. Overwrite?
directionLabelsApplied: Direction text applied to {count} sections. Undo reverses the entire overwrite.
directionRequired: A direction identifier is required for a ride section.
directionsDistinct: Forward and reverse direction identifiers must differ.
arrivalHelpForward: Optional: after this section, use this direction code to continue on the same vehicle without a transfer. Leave blank to keep direction. This code is not shown as direction text in planner results.
arrivalHelpReverse: Optional: after travelling this section in reverse, use this direction code to continue on the same vehicle without a transfer. Leave blank to keep reverseDirection. The diagram also applies to reverse travel. This code is not shown as direction text in planner results.
arrivalHelpDiagram: A figure-9 through route: travel from A to J using IN, switch to LOOP at J, then continue to B without changing vehicles.
arrivalHelpExample: Figure-9 example: A → J uses direction = IN and arrivalDirection = LOOP. At J, continue straight onto the J → B LOOP section without a transfer. IN and LOOP are example codes.
rideTimeHelp: Ride time = dwell seconds at the departure (previous) station + travel seconds until the train stops at the arrival station. Exclude dwell after arrival. Reverse time uses the reverse departure station. A matching time variant overrides the base time.
walkTimeHelp: Walking seconds for this connection; do not add train dwell time. Reverse time covers walking in the opposite direction. A matching time variant overrides the base time.
transferTimeHelp: Seconds to move between the specified lines/directions within the same station; do not add train dwell time. Reverse time covers the opposite movement.
variantsHelp: A JSON array: when matches horse speed or express-cart settings; timeSec specifies base time (rides include departure dwell, not arrival dwell). Only the first match is used; no match disables the connection. Both directions use the connection’s unfamiliar-traveler setting. Enter [] to remove conditions and use base timing. See the documentation for fields and examples.
footerDescriptionHelp: A JSON object mapping language codes to footer text, e.g. {"zh":"不計等車時間","en":"Waiting time excluded"}. Add languages such as ja as needed. Values are plain text; missing languages fall back to English; without English, no text is shown.
faresHelp: This JSON object contains the entire fare configuration, not just the fare matrix. type selects free, additive or origin-destination fares; currency is the currency, matrix holds origin/destination fares, and externalTransfers defines out-of-station transfer rules. See the documentation for fields and examples.
optionsHelp: This JSON object defines routing preferences, transfer coefficients, horse speeds and express-cart levels. defaults sets initial choices. comparators specifies comparison order and weights for each preference. Defaults must appear in their corresponding allowed lists. See the documentation for fields and examples.
editorSearchstations: Station name, ID, code, alias or game XYZ coordinates
editorSearchedges: Connection ID, station name/code, line or direction code
chooseStation: Choose a search result or enter an exact station name/code.
delayWhenUnfamiliar: Can an unfamiliar traveler be delayed on this connection?
familiarityHelp: When checked, familiarity increases this connection’s time: seconds = base seconds × (0.2 × coefficient + 0.8) + 5/3 × (coefficient − 1). For a 20-second base, coefficients 1/4/7 give 20/37/54 seconds. Unchecked means fixed base timing. Each direction uses its own base time; time variants use the same checkbox. New transfers default to enabled; new rides and walks default to disabled.
transferGraphHint: Select an arrow or a row below to edit a transfer. Drag empty space to pan; use the wheel or buttons to zoom. Numbers are base seconds; differing directions show forward/reverse.
anyDirectionHint: A line ID without a colon means any direction; direction-specific endpoints remain separate. Only existing transfers are drawn; no connections are added.
batchBackup: This CSV list is not a full map backup. It omits bend points, station styles and other map data. Use Download JSON to save the complete map.
batchTravel: Rides and walks on one line
batchStationsHint: Each row is a station: number, English name, Chinese name, game X Y Z coordinates (space-separated, optional). New stations are placed using nearby existing stations. Existing map positions stay unchanged.
batchEdgesHint: Each row is a connection. Leave its number blank to add one with an automatic number. Keep an existing number to edit that connection and preserve its bend points. Only the selected line or station is affected.
batchDeleteHint: Removing a row deletes that item. Changing a station number deletes the old station and adds a new one; deleting stations also removes related connections, aliases and fare settings. The next step shows all changes without applying them.
batchFormatHint: Keep the header row and column order. Use true/false for checkboxes and ride/walk for the connection type. Multilingual text and conditional times use JSON. Quote cells containing commas, newlines or quotes, doubling quotes inside the cell; follow the generated examples.
batchPreserve: Other existing data omitted from this list is preserved. New connections have no bend points; adjust them on the map after applying. For arrival direction and other field meanings, see the help buttons in the regular editor.
batchReviewHint: {count} items will be added, updated or deleted. All changes below apply together and can be undone in one step.
batchNoChanges: The list matches the current data. No changes to apply.
batchEstimated: The new map position was estimated from nearby existing stations and can be adjusted after applying.
batchFallback: No usable reference coordinates were found. The station will appear at the visible map center; check its position manually.
batchDiscard: Discard unapplied changes to this list?
batchCSVQuote: Invalid CSV quoting near line {line}. See the input guide.
batchHeader: Keep the generated header row and its column order.
batchColumnsError: Line {line} needs {count} columns. Check commas and quotes.
batchID: Invalid number on line {line}. Station numbers are required; use letters, digits or _ : # . -.
batchNumberError: Enter zero or a positive number for {field} on line {line}.
batchBoolean: Use true or false for {field} on line {line}.
batchCoordinates: Invalid game coordinates on line {line}. Enter X Y Z numbers or leave blank.
batchOutside: Connection {id} on line {line} belongs to another list. Switch to its line or station to edit it.
batchKind: Use ride or walk for the connection type on line {line}.
batchInvalid: Some list values need fixing. Nothing has been applied. Check stations, lines, directions and times.
batchScopeError: Select an existing line or station first.
stationWarning: This station may have incomplete travel or transfer connections
stationWarningsHint: These editor-only hints do not block edits or change data. One-way transfers count as connected. Ordinary stops that continue on the same line are exempt. Select a station to edit it.
warningNoArrival: No ride or walk can currently arrive at this station.
warningDisconnected: Station transfers form separate groups. Check for missing connections:
warningMissingTransfer: Some external connections are not linked to station transfers. Check:
batchRecordInvalid: Check this item’s stations, line, times and field values.
batchUnknownStation: A station was not found. Check the departure and destination numbers.
batchEndpointError: Check that the line or transfer point exists. Rides and walks need different departure and destination stations.
batchLanguageError: Multilingual text needs language/text pairs, for example {"zh":"往河岸","en":"To River"}.
batchConditionError: Check the conditional-time list, options and seconds. See the field help in the regular editor.
connectionDraftHint: Complete the stations or transfer endpoints. You can edit other fields meanwhile. Valid, complete changes are applied automatically. Incomplete changes stay out of the map and JSON and can be cancelled.
finishConnection: Complete this connection or cancel its pending changes before continuing.
